title: Reviewer unable to add comments for R1 version - reply button not visible
description: Reviewer attempting to review R1 version cannot locate reply button to add comments. When attempting to submit review, system shows error: "You need to add comments or address author replies to submit your review". However, no interface option exists to add comments or replies. This blocks the reviewer from completing the review submission.

title: Summary Tab: Reply button is missing for R1 review
description: In the Summary Tab, the reply button is not displayed for reviewers attempting to add comments on R1 version. The interface shows the review form but lacks the button needed to add or edit comments. Reviewer cannot proceed with adding review feedback.

title: Reviewer unable to submit review comments in Revision 2 - reply option unavailable
description: In Revision 2, the reviewer lacks the option to add replies or comments. The reply feature is completely absent from the interface. Reviewer cannot submit review comments for R2 and workflow is blocked.

title: Reviewer reply button missing for R1 version - form validation error
description: Reviewer attempting to review R1 receives error: "You must add comments and a recommendation before sending the review to the editor". However, no interface option exists to add further comments. The reply button is missing from the form, making it impossible to satisfy the system requirement.

title: Author missing "Submit response to reviews" option - only sees Export button
description: Author accessing "View and reply to reviews" link can only see the "Export review" option. The "Submit response to reviews" option (documented in user guide) is missing. Additionally, clicking on reviewers' "Comments" or "Summary" sections does not bring up the response box/field. Authors are unable to submit replies to reviewers and cannot proceed with revised manuscript submission.

title: Reviewer unable to add comments for R1 - reply button missing from interface
description: Reviewer in R1 review workflow encounters missing reply button for adding comments. System error states: "You must add comments and a recommendation before sending the review to the editor" but no interface provides option to add further comments. Form submission is blocked despite having content to review.

title: File upload timeout when submitting revision manuscript
description: Author attempts to upload revised manuscript PDF (15 MB). Upload starts but hangs at 60-70% completion. After 5 minutes, browser times out with error: "Connection reset by peer". Revision cannot be submitted.

title: Manuscript file upload fails for large documents
description: During revision submission, uploading a 20 MB PDF file fails after 2 minutes with error: "Upload failed - server error 500". The file never appears in the system. Smaller files (under 5 MB) upload successfully.

title: Supplementary file upload stuck in progress state
description: Author uploads supplementary materials (3 MB zip file). Progress bar shows 100% but the upload button remains disabled. System shows file as pending indefinitely. Cannot complete manuscript submission without this file.

title: Revision document upload fails repeatedly with network error
description: Reviewer uploads marked-up revision file (docx, 8 MB). Upload fails with "Network error - please retry" message. Works on first attempt 50% of the time. File format validation appears to reject some docx versions.

title: Multiple file upload causes browser to freeze
description: When uploading multiple manuscript files simultaneously (PDF, Word, supplementary), the browser freezes for 30+ seconds. Sometimes one file fails to upload while others succeed partially. Inconsistent behavior across browsers.

title: Uploaded manuscript file corrupted after successful upload
description: Author uploads revision (12 MB PDF). Upload completes successfully with no errors. However, when editor downloads the file for review, it's corrupted and cannot be opened. MD5 hash shows file was altered during transfer.

title: File upload hangs at 99% - never completes
description: User uploads manuscript files. Progress bar reaches 99% and stays there indefinitely. The upload appears stuck. Closing the browser tab loses all progress. Resuming upload is not possible.

title: Unsupported file format error on valid PDF uploads
description: System rejects PDF files with error: "File format not supported". Same PDF files can be uploaded via API but not via web UI. The validation logic in the web form appears overly strict.

title: File upload quota exceeded even after cleanup
description: Author receives error: "Upload quota exceeded - 5 GB limit". User deleted old revisions but storage still shows as full. Previous files should have freed up space but system shows no change.

title: Reviewer unable to download PDF format in new peer review platform
description: Reviewer completes their review and attempts to download the PDF manuscript to attach notes for their own records. The download button is either missing or returns an error. PDF format is not available for download. Reviewer cannot export manuscript for reference.

title: Editor unable to view or download review comments from reviewers
description: Editor of journal cannot view or download review comments received from five reviewers on the NPRE page. The review comments list returns empty. However, the same comments are visible when accessing via JM profile. The Download Review option returns error when accessed under editor proxy. Issue is permission/visibility related for proxy roles.

title: PDF download issue for reviewer on new Journal platform
description: Reviewer experiences persistent PDF download failures on the new journal platform. The download link is clickable but fails silently or returns a broken file. This prevents the reviewer from working offline with the manuscript. Affects multiple reviewers across different journals.

title: Pop-up error preventing reviewer from downloading manuscript for review
description: Reviewer attempts to download the manuscript file but a pop-up error appears blocking the download action. The error message is vague and does not provide path to resolution. Download functionality fails. If reviewer dismisses the popup, they can view the NORE page but the manuscript download still fails. The download should complete without error popup interference.

title: Reviewer sees "We can't show this page" when opening View and Review Manuscript link
description: Reviewer tries to submit the review report, but when clicking the action link "View and Review Manuscript" the platform opens an error page stating "We can't show this page". The manuscript review page never loads, so the reviewer cannot complete the report submission.

title: Mac Safari editor access fails with "We can't show this page" authentication error
description: Editor using Mac Safari with Apple sign-in attempts to open the manuscript review workflow and receives message: "We can't show this page". The issue appears tied to an authentication failure and prevents the editor from accessing the requested page.

title: Invitation link opens "We can't show you this page" access error
description: User opening the invitation link is shown message: "We can't show you this page. You might have entered an incorrect URL, or tried to access a page you don't have access to." The page also notes access is linked to the email address where the invitation was sent. User cannot proceed into the service.

title: Multiple reviewers report "We can't show this page" when navigating from EM to Quantum
description: Support has received repeated reviewer complaints that EM review links into the Quantum platform fail with error "We can't show this page". The issue is becoming the most common technical problem reported. Reviewers are blocked before reaching the review screen.

title: Editor proxy cannot open reviewer manuscript page and receives blank access error
description: Editor attempts to proxy a reviewer and clicks "View and review the manuscript" but receives message "We can't show you this page". Refreshing does not resolve the problem. Proxy workflow cannot access the reviewer page.

title: Submission inaccessible in editor and reviewer roles with "We can't show you this page"
description: Users cannot access the submission in any role, including editor and reviewer. Every attempt returns error "We can't show you this page" instead of the manuscript details. The issue affects core access across roles and completely blocks the workflow.

title: Author unable to open View and Reply to Reviews page despite correct invited email
description: Author clicks the "View and Reply to the Reviews" link and is directed to a page displaying "We can't show you this page". The error text suggests access is tied to the email address that originally received the invitation. Author confirmed sign-in with the correct email but still cannot access the review response page.

title: Reviewer and proxy both hit access error while direct review page loads blank
description: Reviewer encounters the "We can't show this page" error while attempting to access the system. Support staff sees the same issue when proxying the reviewer. When directly opening "view review and comments", the page remains blank and keeps loading instead of rendering content.

title: Author cannot view reviewer comments and peer review download opens blank page
description: Author is unable to view reviewer comments after clicking "View and reply to reviews". In addition, downloading the peer review opens a blank page instead of the expected content. The issue prevents the author from reading feedback and preparing a response.

title: Agreed reviewer sees blank page from EM when opening Views Reviews and Comments
description: An agreed reviewer cannot navigate from EM to the NPRE experience. After clicking the "Views Reviews and Comments" link, the reviewer only sees a blank page. The review content does not load and no actionable error details are presented.

title: Reviewer submitted comments in NPRE but EM still shows Partial Review Saved
description: A reviewer submitted review comments in NPRE, but EM still shows the review status as Partial Review Saved. There is no option to Send Review or mark the review as complete. The review workflow is blocked despite the comments already being submitted.

title: Journal team requests Partial Review Saved status changed to Complete for two journals
description: Per editor request, support needs the review status updated from Partial Review Saved to Complete for submissions in Journal-1 and Journal-2. The reviews are treated as incomplete in EM even though the editorial team expects them to be complete.

title: Reviewer comments submitted but reviewer status tab still shows Partial Review Saved
description: The reviewer submitted all comments in EM, but the reviewer status tab still shows Partial Review Saved. The manuscript remains listed under Pending Assignments in the reviewer profile. Reviewer cannot complete the review and needs the state corrected.

title: Review recommendation submitted in NPRE but review remains Partial Saved
description: One review is showing as Partial Saved even though the reviewer submitted the review recommendation in the NPRE platform. The recommendation appears to have been sent, but the review status did not move to complete. Editorial staff asked for investigation and resolution.

title: Completed review remains in Partial Review Saved instead of Completed Review
description: A completed reviewer submission still shows the status Partial Review Saved. The journal team requested the status to be updated to Completed Review from the backend because the front-end workflow no longer allows the reviewer to change it.

title: Reviewer cannot update review after status remains Partial Review Saved
description: The reviewer submitted comments, but the status still shows Partial Review Saved and the reviewer no longer has the option to edit or update the review. The status should be Review Complete. Support requested backend correction.

title: Two NPRE reviewers submitted comments but status remains Partial Review Saved
description: Two reviewers submitted their review comments through NPRE, but both reviews still show Partial Review Saved. The journal team requested investigation because the reviews should have advanced to a completed state after submission.

title: Reviewer profile still shows Pending Assignments after all comments were submitted
description: All reviewer comments were submitted in EM, but the reviewer status tab still shows Partial Review Saved and the reviewer profile still lists the manuscript under Pending Assignments. The review state appears stuck and prevents normal completion.

title: Partial Review Saved blocks reopening submit review comments for Minor Revision recommendation
description: EM shows Review Status as Partial Review Saved while the recommendation is Minor Revision. Support requested that the partial review state be changed and the submit review comments option reopened for the reviewer so the review can be completed correctly.

title: Reviewer cannot complete peer review because EM and NPRE review states disagree
description: The reviewer is unable to complete the peer review. In EM, the submission appears under Pending Review Assignments, but in NPRE the system says changes can no longer be made because the review was sent to the editor. The inconsistent state blocks the reviewer from finishing the workflow.

title: Partially saved reviewer recommendation remains stuck after review submission
description: Support requested help with a partially saved reviewer recommendation. In another case from the same journal, the reviewer submitted the review with a Reject recommendation and no comments, but EM still shows the review as Partial Review Saved instead of completed.

title: Reviewer unable to add comments in Quantum while EM shows Partial Review Saved recommendation
description: EM shows Under Review and places the submission in the Pending Assignments folder for the reviewer. In Quantum, the reviewer cannot add comments. The recommendation should be Minor Revision, but EM still shows Partial Review Saved and needs correction.

title: Peer review locked in NPRE while EM still lists submission under Pending Review Assignments
description: The reviewer cannot complete the peer review because EM still lists the submission under Pending Review Assignments, while NPRE displays a message that changes can no longer be made because the review was already sent to the editor. The workflow is stuck across systems.

title: Support cannot edit reviewer comments after Safari pop-up issue leaves review partially saved
description: The journal team asked support to update reviewer comments from the backend after the user hit a Safari pop-up blocker while editing comments. In NPRE there is no Edit option available, and the review status now shows Partially Saved. The missing edit path prevents completing the review on the reviewer's behalf.

title: Accept recommendation remains Partial Review Saved and submission stays in Pending Assignments
description: EM shows Under Review with Review Status set to Partial Review Saved, while the recommendation in Quantum is Accept. The journal team requested the status to be changed to Review Complete and the submission moved from Pending Assignments to Completed Reviews.

title: Reviewer comments cannot be fully saved and review remains partially saved
description: A reviewer completed the review, but some comments were not saved in full. Attempts to edit and add the missing portions were not captured after saving. Support suspects the existing truncation bug and requested a fix because the review remains effectively partially saved.
